review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: The VeltCommentDialog options dropdown is a light-DOM CDK overlay (velt-comment-dialog-options-dropdown-container -> -content -> -content-item) reachable by class CSS, but its ITEM SET is SDK-defined (Assign comment / Mark as unread / Unsubscribe / Delete thread). Class CSS can restyle/hide rows but cannot INJECT new items (e.g. Edit, Copy link). Matching a design menu with different actions needs a wireframe options-content slot.

VeltCommentsSidebar (even embedMode+pageMode under host setUnstyledMode) renders its content INSIDE A SHADOW ROOT; class CSS cannot cross the boundary (only CSS variables do). Its minimal-filter / sort dropdown trigger is not present in light DOM (count 0 even to shadow-piercing Playwright locators) when the embedded sidebar is empty. A sidebar sub-surface (sort/filter menu) is therefore not primitives-stylable in this host without surfacing the sidebar in light DOM.

VeltCommentDialog (fullExpanded, shadowDom=false) always renders a status dropdown, inline assignee/metadata, five banners (visibility/private/assignee/ghost/agent-suggestion), header, action-bar, and a persistent reply composer. A design's minimal thread card (avatar/name/time + resolve + options + Reply affordance) is a full restructure -> VeltCommentDialogWireframe, not primitives class-CSS. Confirmed across three loops on this design family.
